notes:
Generate from dimensions (new in CHR-1062; tool `generate_personas`). Same dialog shell, 580px. Drawn after **Preview** was clicked. Title "Generate from dimensions" (CHR-1146; was "Generate personas from dimensions").

Body: **Generate** target switch (CHR-1146; `uc-segmented two-first`: Personas / Constellations → `target`; switching clears the preview; Constellations is drawn in `usecases-generate-dialog-constellations`. Opened from the persona pool it starts on Personas, from the World pool on Constellations). Lede ("Expands your dimensions into generic personas. Existing personas that already cover a combination are skipped. Preview first: nothing is written until you create."), Strategy (`uc-segmented two-first`: Pairwise (recommended) / All combinations), Dimensions (one checkbox per dimension with scope Personas and its value count, all checked by default; "traits on other dimensions are ignored"; none checked disables Preview), Limit (number input, 1–5,000, default 100), **Preview** (secondary) = a dry run.

Preview result (`aria-live="polite"`): summary "**9 would be created** · 33 value pairs in total · 24 already covered by existing personas" (+ " · cut off by the limit" when truncated), then up to 12 names with their traits (mono, tertiary) and "… and N more". Nothing to create → "Nothing to create: every combination is already covered." Changing any input clears the preview and disables Create again.

Footer: Close, primary **Create N personas** (disabled until a preview with at least one persona). Flows: close / Close / Create → `usecases-personas`; target Constellations → `usecases-generate-dialog-constellations`.
